readme.text:
# Unified CDN ☁️
Unified CDN is a **all-in-one file storage network**, connecting to multiple file storage providers from a **single endpoint**.

With Unified CDN API, you can interact with your self-hosted Unified CDN instance easily, with fully typed methods and errors.

To get started, visit the [documentation](https://docs.unified-cdn.ngqian.com).
